chapter.heading: Isaiah 14
The Restoration of Jacob
chapter.v: For the Lord will have compassion on Jacob and will again choose Israel , andwill set them in their own land , andsojourners will join them and will attach themselves to the house of Jacob .

Andthe peoples will take them and bring them to their place , and the house of Israel will possess them in the Lord ’s landas male and female slaves .They will take captive those who were their captors ,and rule over those who oppressed them .
When the Lord has given you rest from your pain and turmoil and the hard service with which you were made to serve ,
the insolent fury ceased !
thescepter of rulers ,
with unrelenting persecution .
they break forth into singing .
no woodcutter comes up against us . ’
all who were kings of the nations .
You have become like us ! ’
and worms are your covers .
you who laid the nations low !
in the far reaches of the north ;
I will make myself like the Most High . ’
to the far reaches of the pit .
who shook kingdoms ,
who did not let his prisoners go home ? ’
each in his own tomb ;
like a dead body trampled underfoot .
nevermore be named !
and fill the face of the world with cities . ”
“ I will rise up against them , ” declares the Lord of hosts , “ and will cut off from Babylon name andremnant ,descendants and posterity , ” declares the Lord .
“ And I will make it a possession of thehedgehog , and pools of water , and I will sweep it with the broom of destruction , ” declares the Lord of hosts .
so shall it stand ,
andhis burden from their shoulder . ”
over all the nations .
and who will turn it back ?
In the year thatKing Ahaz died came thisoracle :
and its fruit will be aflying fiery serpent .
and your remnant it will slay .
and there is no straggler in his ranks .
and in her the afflicted of his people find refuge . ”
